comment_text:
While I am not an admirer of Apple, I must acknowledge—after purchasing the Samsung Galaxy S25—that the device falls short in terms of battery performance. This shortfall is largely attributable to Samsung’s emphasis on achieving a slim form factor, which results in a reduced battery capacity. Consequently, the phone struggles to last a full day under moderate use, and the standby power drain is notably higher compared to that of the iPhone.

For context, I also use my  employer-issued iPhone 15 alongside the S25, allowing me to compare their performance in daily usage scenarios. Based on this direct comparison, I find the iPhone 15 delivers superior battery life under similar conditions. My usage includes browsing, YouTube, Instagram, GPS navigation, and regular phone calls, with no gaming involved.

Additionally, the Galaxy S25 tends to exhibit heating issues during regular use—a concern occasionally observed in the iPhone as well, no complaints there. Ultimately, my primary grievance centers on inadequate battery endurance. The trade-off between slim design and battery capacity, which often necessitates carrying an external power bank, is unsatisfactory for my needs.

I sincerely hope @Samsung takes this feedback into account in future product designs.

Q: How does Circle to Search work?
A: Just circle an object—including images, videos, or text—with your finger or S Pen and you'll get results immediately.

Q: Does Live Translate only work during calls?
A: No. It also works through messaging. You can reply in your selected language and it will be translated for the person you're chatting with.
